_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). The activated ability was then authored as BANISH target=opponent, but the card banishes nothing -- it is 'target hero discards a card unless they pay {r}', which is exactly PAY_OR_ELSE. While BANISH ignored its target this only banished the controller's own top card; once BANISH honoured the target it would have banished the OPPONENT's, which looks right and is not. Blade Break is a printed keyword and needs no ability here.
